title: feat(console): Change Owner on the record page, the list selection bar and the edit form (part of #35403)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XP3RHGWUG7UH3fNa4tBa9UC)_
Part of #35403

Handed over before it was finished (maintainer handover, 06:26Z). This PR leaves the list half and three test families open; see Tests.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 控制台用户在记录页、列表批量选择栏和编辑表单上能看到「更改负责人」操作;编辑表单里负责人以只读显示,操作就在旁边。
- 这是「更改负责人」三张卡里的最后一张(控制台界面);服务端接口和规则判断已经在前两张卡里合并。
- 出错时最坏的情况是该显示的按钮没显示,或者在服务端本会拒绝的地方多显示了一个按钮;不改服务端,也不改任何数据规则,撤回这次合并即可。
- 无。

## What changes

**The record page.** The header gets a **Change Owner** entry in its `⋯` menu (`sys_change_owner`, in `RecordDetailView`'s built-in header entries). It is drawn only when all three facts hold, as ruled:

1. The object is structurally eligible.
2. Its switch `userActions.transfer` is on. Facts 1 and 2 come from the spec's one resolution, `resolveUserActionTransfer` in `@objectstack/spec/data`.
3. The explain engine's `transfer` verdict for this record is a definite allow.

The verdict comes from the record page's existing single read. Its `explain` list now asks `transfer` wherever facts 1 and 2 hold. `seedRecordPageReaders` seeds that answer into the same verdict cache `useRecordVerdict` reads, so there is no second per-record request. The queue Claim shares the same answer. If `disabledWhen` holds for the record, the entry is drawn disabled with the reason beside it, as the CRUD entries are.

**One dialog** (`ChangeOwnerDialog`), used by the record action, the form action and the bulk action:

- The picker is labelled with the object's own label for `owner_id`. The served label is passed through `fieldLabel`, and "Owner" (i18n) is used only when the object serves none.
- You can pick a person, or a queue where the object carries the ADR-0142 `queue` column. The column is read off the served definition; queues are read from `sys_queue` only once the queue target is chosen.
- An optional notify checkbox sends `notify: true` only when ticked.
- One record calls `data.changeOwner`; two or more call `data.changeOwnerMany`. Both come from `@objectstack/client`. There is no server, spec, SDK or REST change.
- A refusal shows the server's own sentence.
- A bulk answer ends in a report: moved, already had this owner, did not move. Every row that did not move is listed with the server's code sentence, unsampled.

**The list.** `ObjectGrid`'s selection bar (and its row context menu's bulk section) offers **Change Owner** where the host wires the new optional `onBulkChangeOwner` prop. `ListView` forwards it. The Console wires it only where facts 1 and 2 hold and the explain engine's `transfer` verdict for the OBJECT is a definite allow. That is the same engine and operation the record page reads, asked once per object at object grain (`POST /security/explain` with no `recordId`), so a list never asks per row. Rows that the switch's `visibleWhen` excludes are left out of the request with the same fail-closed fold the bulk Delete runs (`partitionRowsByPredicate`), and the dialog says how many it left out. The server judges every remaining row again.

**The default edit form.** `owner_id` is still dropped from the form's fields by `filterSystemFields` / `SERVER_OWNED_FIELD_NAMES` and never written by the form. It is now shown read-only on its own line above the fields, using the `user` widget with `readonly`, with the host's action beside it. The line appears only under a host that mounts `FormOwnerLineContext`, exported from `@object-ui/plugin-form` and its `/core` entry. The Console mounts it around its global edit dialog (`AppContent`'s `LazyModalForm`) and the page-mode form (`RecordFormPage`). The action chunk loads lazily, so the shell does not import `@object-ui/plugin-form` eagerly. `vite.config.ts`'s `plugin-form-core` chunk names the new context module. An embedded form without the context is unchanged.

**Answers to the order's Zone 2:**

1. Mount points: `RecordDetailView`'s built-in header entries, `ObjectGrid`'s legacy bulk-action names next to the built-in Delete, wired from `ObjectView` → `objectViewListRenderer` → `ListView`, and the form's owner line in `ModalForm` (flat arm) and `ObjectForm` (both arms).
2. The `transfer` operation is reachable through the record page payload and is reused as described above.
3. The queue target is offered where the served definition carries `queue`.
4. The form keeps `sanitize.ts` unchanged and shows the owner on its own line.
5. The #30205 `TransferReportView` is a multi-object, per-field report with `remaining`, so it does not fit one object's answer. `ChangeOwnerReportView` renders the same failure rows (id plus the server's sentence) for `ChangeOwnerReport`.

**Strings.** All new strings are added in all 11 console locales: `grid.changeOwner` and the `console.changeOwner.*` block.

## Tests

Head `2b6a0ba8fb`. Readings below were taken on earlier heads, as named.

- Card tests `changeOwner-35403.test.tsx` and `bulkChangeOwner-35403.test.tsx`: 27/27 passed on `d314bd48ea`; the app-shell file passed 25/25 on `e312208b90`. The four list-gate cases added in `c5b500d95c` were **not run**.
- Ablations, one per visibility leg, made with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` against committed HEAD, each restore proved by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`:
  - Structural leg: 3 red (ownership none, managedBy, sys_*).
  - Switch leg: 2 red (controlled_by_parent default, private switched off).
  - Verdict leg: 3 red (refused, unanswered, the form's edit-without-transfer line).
- Type-check passed for app-shell, plugin-grid, plugin-form, plugin-detail, plugin-list and i18n on `d314bd48ea`.
- **Open reds, found by the full package suites:**
  1. Plugins suite on `db787e9669`: 6 failed. Five were i18n pins (two count families, de quote count, a format-string identity, zh-Hant staleness). They are fixed in `2b6a0ba8fb` but not re-run. The sixth is the affordance-grant census in plugin-form: the list gate read `checkField(owner_id, write)`. `c5b500d95c` replaced that read with the explain engine's object-level `transfer` verdict, which is also what the ruling names.
  2. App-shell suite on `c5b500d95c`, partial run: 7 files red.
     - Five `ObjectView.*` files and `AppContent.draftSaveKeepsList-35932`. The cause has not been read. The likely cause is the new object-level explain request reaching tests that have no double for it.
     - `RecordDetailView.recordPagePayload-27627`, whose pin on the page request's `explain` list now sees `transfer`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a full `packages/` build) and `check:type-check-debt` (stopped before it ran; it needs a full `packages/` build). CI runs both.

## Acceptance notes

- **N1 (the echo): a row whose owner already was the person picked reads "already had this owner", not "moved".** The endpoint counts such a row in `updated`, but its owner did not change, and calling it moved would report a change that never happened. On one record the dialog leaves the current owner out of the picker. If the current owner is named anyway, Change Owner stays off with the reason shown, so no echo call is sent. In a bulk report, a row that did not fail and that the list read with that owner already is counted as unchanged (`readChangeOwnerReport`); the count is capped at what the server counted updated. A queue target has no person to compare, so every admitted row reads as moved.
- **Change Owner is drawn on a definite allow only, on the record page, the form and the list.** A deployment whose explain engine answers nothing (no security plugin) shows no Change Owner anywhere. This is the same rule the queue Claim beside it follows.
- **Row cap.** `USER_WORK_TRANSFER_ROW_CAP` (500) lives only in `@objectstack/core`, which the UI cannot import, and `@objectstack/client` does not export it. The bulk dialog therefore sends the whole selection in one call. Over 500 rows, the server's own `VALIDATION_ERROR` sentence is shown. This is raised as an open question in the report; the cap is not copied into the UI.
- **Not wired here** (carrier: none; noted, not filed): the non-grid `ListView` bulk surfaces. `onBulkChangeOwner` reaches the grid only.
- A grid with exactly one row ticked offers the same entry, and the dialog then makes a one-record change through `data.changeOwner`.
- **An edit form left dirty while the owner changes.** The form re-reads the record in place only while it is pristine. A dirty form saved after a Change Owner may meet the record's version check. Nothing here changes that behaviour.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/changeOwner.ts`, `useRecordChangeOwnerOffer`: the three-fact gate and the `verdict === true` hunk.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordPagePayload.ts`: `transfer` now seeds the record verdict as well as the Claim reader.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: `effectiveBulkActions` and the `dispatchBulkAction` branch.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/changeOwner-35403.test.tsx`. Expected: the card's pins green; the list-gate cases are unverified. Each visibility leg has its own red under ablation; see Tests.
